run_locomotion_controller_example: run the Laikago quadruped robot locomotion controller example with a specified gait pattern in simulation
generate_speed_profile: generate a time-based linear and angular speed profile using scipy interpolation for robot locomotion demo
update_controller_params: update the swing and stance leg controller desired speed and twisting speed parameters
load_robot_config: load simulation or real robot configuration for the quadruped locomotion controller environment
update_speed_from_keyboard: update the robot controller linear and angular speed parameters using keyboard input controls
